answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 7642 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible to have a shower or should one rather have a bucket bath? Also, is it permissible to stand and bathe or should one rather sit and bathe? Question: Is it permissible to have a shower or should one rather have a bucket bath? Also, is it permissible to stand and bathe or should one rather sit and bathe? Answer ID: 7642 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 968/968=M/1429) One can have bath as per his easiness, it is allowed. However, it is better to bath sitting with a bucket. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
